name: Takamine Atsushi
source: The protagonist of the hidden "Fireworks" scenario. [url=/c140352]Takamine Ryuuji[/url]'s father. Executive of the home appliance manufacturer "Yotsubishi". He is very awkward and cannot express his feelings honestly, so he pretends to be strict to hide this. However, his son Ryuuji could not tolerate his behavior and left home.
